done_when: forge doctor and forge upgrade print one suggested fast_test line for the repo's test kind: Python repos get forge test --pytest {base}; vitest or jest repos get their runner on changed files with --passWithNoTests using the repo's own install and runner; mixed repos get one part per kind; Go, Rust, Java, .NET and Ruby repos get no line; skill.md says so; new and existing client repos each have a command test

findings.body: The previous direct-executable finding remains open. For `uv run pytest && npm ci && ./node_modules/.bin/eslint . && npm test`, with npm test invoking Vitest or Jest, direct ESLint receives an empty kind. The Python picker retains it while removing npm installation and the Node runner (src/forge/fasttest.py:120–121), then executes it at line 171. When Python tests are selected or shared inputs change, the suggested command fails before reaching installation if dependencies are absent; otherwise ESLint runs twice. Direct local checks such as `./node_modules/.bin/tsc` have the same problem. This direct-executable case goes beyond the coordinator's isolation ruling. Classify these checks consistently so both doctor and upgrade suggestions execute them once after installation.
findings.title: Keep installation before direct Node checks in mixed suggestions

findings.body: The previous trailing-option finding remains open. `npm exec jest --workspace=web` becomes `npm exec -- jest --workspace=web --changedSince {base} --passWithNoTests`. Moving the separator before the runner turns npm's workspace selection into a runner argument, losing the intended execution context. Vitest and other trailing npm configuration options are affected through both doctor and upgrade. [npm's documented contract](https://docs.npmjs.com/cli/v11/commands/npm-exec/#npx-vs-npm-exec) confirms that npm parses options after positional arguments until `--`. This trailing-option case goes beyond the earlier leading-option repair. Preserve npm's configuration options before the inserted separator.
findings.title: Preserve trailing npm options when inserting the exec separator

why: Repos without a quick test setting don't learn which quick test command fits them
